description: Draws one economic series over time in the chat as an interactive chart, e.g. unemployment, CPI or the federal funds rate. Call it when the user asks to see or plot an indicator, or when that chart is itself the answer. Find the series id with SearchEconomicIndicators. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetEconomicIndicator returns the observations.

endDate.description: Last observation date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: latest).

seriesId.description: FRED series id, e.g. UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, FEDFUNDS.

startDate.description: First observation date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the data tool's default range).

name: ShowEconomicChart
title: Show Economic Chart
